summary: Flat, shaded kerb where a car already parks; homes 13-23 m away.

best_section.where: West kerb under the trees, where the parked car sits

flags: Narrow lane: a van may block passing cars
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the best section, mainly from the west and south.
